Chapter 463: Chapter 9 All are Provisions (Please Subscribe)

“`

“Who would have thought that the Cosmic Force that countless Eighth Layer powerhouses in the Main World yearn for, I actually grasped its rudimentary form during my Third Rank and Fourth Rank?”

Lin Yuan couldn’t help but feel emotional in his heart. The so-called Cosmic Force not only enhances combat power for Eighth Layer powerhouses.

In the future, if one could step into the Ninth Rank or even higher, the transformation of Cosmic Force would be even greater.

For Eighth Layer Evolvers to comprehend Cosmic Force, regardless of whether they can succeed, it would undoubtedly take a considerable amount of time, possibly tens of thousands or even hundreds of thousands of years.

But the Cosmic Force comprehended at the Eighth Layer level, besides the enhancement in combat power, does not help much in breaking through to the Ninth Layer.

...

Yet, in the Main World, there are still a great number of powerhouses of various clans who wish to walk the path of the invincible at the Eighth Layer.

This seems quite incredible, for after all, spending this time on Fusion Rules might give one a better chance of stepping into the Ninth Layer.

In fact, if one can comprehend Cosmic Force at the Eighth Layer, should they be able to break through to the Ninth Layer in the future, they would be able to walk further along the Ninth Layer’s path.

Unfortunately, among Eighth Layer powerhouses, those who have comprehended Cosmic Force are too few.

And even among those Eighth Layer individuals who have comprehended Cosmic Force, the number that eventually step into the Ninth Layer is even rarer.

Out of tens of thousands of Eighth Layer powerhouses, it is considered extremely lucky if one who comprehends Cosmic Force manages to step into the Ninth Layer.

“My Taiji Force…”

Lin Yuan carefully felt his own Cosmic Force. The transformed Taiji Force was no longer divided into Taiyin and Taiyang. It seemed innate and flawless.

“They all say that Cosmic Force cannot be replicated, my Taiji Force…” Lin Yuan reflected inwardly before finally shaking his head.

This statement is essentially correct.

Lin Yuan’s Taiji Force is derived from the fusion of Taiyin and Taiyang.

Even if, in future generations, a Martial Dao Cultivator with supreme Talent in Taiyin and Taiyang emerges, just like Lin Yuan, mastering both Taiyin and Taiyang.

It’s debatable whether they could fuse Taiyin and Taiyang, and even if they truly managed to do so, the power formed would most likely not be Taiji Force.

Lin Yuan’s Taiji Force was not created with equal proportions of Taiyin and Taiyang, but rather adjusted according to his own adaptability.

Only then did the new Taiji Force come into being.

Future Martial Dao Cultivators, even if they fuse Taiyin and Taiyang, the force they create will not be Lin Yuan’s Taiji Force.

“With my current strength, unleashing full power, I should be able to easily suppress other invincible Eighth Layers, but to say defeat or even kill…”

Lin Yuan thought about it for a while and felt it was unrealistic.

After grasping the Taiji Force, Lin Yuan’s understanding of such Cosmic Force deepened even further.

Even if Lin Yuan used all his trump cards, at most he could only suppress. Forcing the opponent to flee would be difficult to achieve.

Take Lin Yuan’s Taiji Force as an example, once he fully defended, it was almost invulnerable to myriad laws. Even ten invincible Eighth Layers might not be able to break through the defense.

This is why in the Main World, those Eighth Layer powerhouses who have comprehended some kind of Cosmic Force are called ‘invincible.’

This is the legend of the invincible at the Eighth Layer.

“Take it slow.”

“I feel that there is still much room for refinement in my Taiji Force.”

Lin Yuan’s thoughts converged. In the Main World, those invincible at the Eighth Layer who have comprehended Cosmic Force tend not to continue exploring it but focus all their energy on the Fusion Rules instead.

Having already spent a tremendous amount of time comprehending Cosmic Force, to continue wasting time, the hope of breaking through to the Ninth Layer becomes even more bleak.

Without breaking through to the Ninth Layer, even an invincible Eighth Layer won’t have a longer life span than those at the peak of the Eighth Layer.

…

The Nine Heavens.

The Fourth Heaven.

Lin Yuan’s Taiyang Divine Spirit and Taiyin Primordial Spirit appeared simultaneously.

They immediately began to merge.

Hum.

The flawless Taiji Primordial Spirit reappeared.

Compared to the previous Taiji Primordial Spirit, this one was purer and had a more stable influence on space.

Lin Yuan even faintly felt that time was also slightly affected.

“This sensation?”

Lin Yuan looked around.

In Xianyao City, even though Lin Yuan had grasped the Taiji Force, a kind of Cosmic Force, he wouldn’t attempt anything risky for fear that a slight mishap might lay waste to the entire city.

But here within the Nine Heavens… there were no such concerns.

The Nine Heavens were vast and boundless, each layer as large as the Spirit Realm, and here the Spirit Realm refers not to the three thousand Dao provinces, but to the entirety of the Spirit Realm.

Moreover, due to environmental reasons, only True Immortal-level Powerhouses could hope to ascend to the Nine Heavens, and even then, only to the first and second layers. In the vast expanse of the Nine Heavens, unless by specific arrangement, it is very difficult to encounter another person.

Therefore, Lin Yuan could act without any worries here.

Boom.

Terrible power began to spread in all directions. The full eruption of Taiji Force was like a primordial beast, wildly stirring everything in the Fourth Heaven.

“What a thrill.”

Lin Yuan laughed out loud, finally understanding the confidence of those invincible at the Eighth Layer in the Main World.

This power that reigns above the Eighth Layer can easily become addictive.

“The strength of my current Taiji Primordial Spirit is not lesser than that of an invincible Eighth Layer, and due to the nature of being an energy and spirit body, it is much more troublesome than ordinary invincible Eighth Layers.”

Lin Yuan had an accurate assessment of his Primordial Spirit.

The Primordial Spirit is not corporeal, unable to benefit from the augmentation of the Mysterious Gourd to the Inner World, but it also has the advantage of the Primordial Spirit, which is immunity to most physical damage.

And since the Primordial Spirit is an ethereal body, it is elusive and unpredictable.

In the Main World, those invincible beings of energy life at the Eighth Layer are more dreaded than ordinary invincible Eighth Layers.
